message.reasoning:
We need to propose a trade. We are p1 (Alpha) with cash 560, holdings: READING_RAILROAD, ST_JAMES_PLACE, TENNESSEE_AVENUE. Others: p2 (Beta) cash 260, holds NEW_YORK_AVENUE. p3 (Gamma) cash 480, holds ORIENTAL_AVENUE, VERMONT_AVENUE, CONNECTICUT_AVENUE (the dark purple set). p4 (Delta) cash 980, holds nothing.

We can propose trade to any of p2,p3,p4. Need to consider strategic value. Our holdings: Reading Railroad (one of four railroads), St James Place (orange? Actually St James Place is orange group with Tennessee Avenue and New York Avenue). Tennessee Avenue also orange. So we have two of the orange set (St James Place, Tennessee Avenue). Missing New York Avenue (owned by Beta). So we could try to get New York Avenue from Beta to complete orange set, which would allow building houses later. Beta only has New York Avenue, cash 260. We have cash 560, could offer cash for it. Also we could offer something else like a railroad? But we only have one railroad. Might be valuable to Beta? He has cash 260, maybe wants cash. So propose to Beta: give cash for New York Avenue. Offer maybe $200 for New York Avenue? Beta would get cash, we get property. But we need to consider fairness: Beta's cash 260, we have 560. If we give $200, we end up with cash 360, still decent. Beta would have cash 460. That seems good for Beta. Could also include maybe a get out of jail card but we have none.

Alternatively, we could propose to Gamma for something else, but they have the other orange? Actually they have the dark purple set (Oriental, Vermont, Connecticut). Not relevant.

Delta has cash 980, no properties. Could propose to buy a property from bank? Not allowed. So best is to propose to Beta for New York Avenue.

We need to fill the propose_trade arguments: offer: cash, properties, get_out_of_jail_cards. request: cash, properties, get_out_of_jail_cards. to_player_id: "p2". public_message: something like "Hey Beta, I'd like to buy New York Avenue for $200. Let me know!" Private thought: reasoning.

Make sure numbers are integers. Offer cash 200, no properties, request property New York Avenue. No cards.

Check max_exchanges 4, but we only need one.

Thus call propose_trade.
